why: The original run_intermediate_sweep.py never produced evidence and did not implement the preregistered gates.
It parsed the runner's RESULT line from stdout, but the runner prints it on stderr, so every field would have been missing.
It required fill to be the boolean True, but parsing yields the string 'true', so every gate would have failed.
It required visited == 0b111 for the TOY gate, which the preregistration does not require and a region-0 toy can never satisfy.
It ran offset controls for the TOY, which the preregistration does not register.
It invoked the extensionless runner path, which Windows CreateProcess does not resolve.
gates_unchanged: TOY and REGIONAL_WITNESS success criteria, controls, failure policy, resource policy and claim rule are applied exactly as frozen in the amended file.

safety_added: OUTPUT_CAP status instead of buffer overflow
@path source form for programs above the argv limit

added_gate.name: IMPLEMENTATION_PARITY_Ek
added_gate.status: NOT in the original preregistration; added here before execution
added_gate.reference: reference_width_vm.py, written from the vm_profile block, with a different algorithm for the top k mod 5 crazy trits
added_gate.rule: Zig runner and reference agree on status, steps, stdout_hex, a, c, d, visited regions, first-entry step and opcode per visited region, initial_tape_sha256 and final_tape_sha256, for every run executed at width k
added_gate.resource_rule: If either implementation cannot allocate or times out, IMPLEMENTATION_PARITY_Ek is NOT_DEMONSTRATED, never FAIL
